verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party bulk operation, such as bulk-editing, archiving or updating many gates or experiments in one action. What exists is only adjacent. Multi-gate evaluation for a single user and batched event logging are runtime ingest and evaluation features, not bulk management of items. The scriptable CLI and Console API are building blocks a user could loop over to build bulk behavior. Layers group experiments for traffic management, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
